$comment: Applied in every locale. `neverTranslate` terms stay exactly as written. `descriptive` terms use the established local term if one exists, otherwise a natural translation; the technique's own page adds the English name in parentheses for SEO.

productTerms.knowledge card: A saved topic with its explanation and questions. Use the word local study apps use for flashcards/cards.
productTerms.review: A scheduled check of a card. Use the term local spaced-repetition apps use (e.g. de: Wiederholung, fr: révision).
productTerms.streak: Consecutive days with a completed focus session. Use the term local habit apps use (e.g. de: Serie, es: racha).
productTerms.focus session: One timed block of focused work.
productTerms.Work mode / Learning mode: The two product modes. Translate naturally; keep consistent across the UI.
